answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 15426 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: Respected Mufti Sahab...Assalamaykum, Please advise me on following points. 1) Washing Hands before meal is Sunnah or mustahab. 2)Can we take the support of the back of chair while eating. Jazakumullah Khair Question: Respected Mufti Sahab...Assalamaykum, Please advise me on following points. 1) Washing Hands before meal is Sunnah or mustahab. 2)Can we take the support of the back of chair while eating. Jazakumullah Khair Answer ID: 15426 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1339/1339=M/1430) It is sunnah. It is mentioned in hadith: برکۃ الطعام الوضوء قبلہ والوضوء بعدہ ( ترمذي ) It is makrooh to eat while leaning against something, as it a hadith says: قال رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم: أ ما أنا فلا آکل متکئا ( ترمذي ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
